notes.title: English Version + Remastered Version Coming this year!
notes.content:
Hi, everyone!
This is Yuriko0v0, the developer of "[b]Abnormal Treatment[/b]."
We apologize for the delay of our previous plans, but we also have big news for everyone, which is…

[h2]The English version and the Remastered Version will be available this year![/h2]

[h3]⭐About English Version:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35458405/54616d6a73ffd4c74b9bf0f5b9b65a8722d18d96.png[/img]
Three years ago, we announced our plan to prepare an English version.

However, back then, we lacked localization experience. The translation did not progress as planned, and work had to be paused after we faced a lot of trouble. >A<

And now, thanks to the help of my friends, I'm happy to announce that the English translation is moving forward again! Right now, our rough translation is quite complete. With the help of native English-speaking players, all text is being proofread step by step.

[previewyoutube=zF67D0E6Zw4;full][/previewyoutube]

Our plan is to release both the English Version and Remastered Version at the same time, and if all goes well, it could be available to everyone this year!🎉
We will carefully complete the English proofreading of the full text, and we truly hope to tell this story well in a different language!♥

[b]⭐You're welcome to download our game in advance, and add it to your Steam library!
Then you'll see the announcement as soon as the English version is released~!⭐[/b]

Also, if you're interested in testing our remastered version in the near future, feel free to send your self-introduction to eternaldream0v0@163.com
Or join our [url=https://discord.gg/ysbxSfYaQs]Discord Server[/url]! 

Again, thank you so much for your patience and help! We appreciate it!

[h3]⭐About Remastered Version:[/h3]
[b]It will support:[/b]
[list]
[*] Full screen with HD images
[*] Refined System Menus, Gameplay Tips and Auto Save
[*] Mouse Mode
[*] New content in the bonus room
[/list]
The upcoming new version is also free to play.
If you want to support us, you can purchase our DLC or sponsor us on Patreon. This will help us a lot!
(Patreon Link: [url=https://patreon.com/EternalDream0v0]https://patreon.com/EternalDream0v0[/url] )

[h3]⭐Where To Find Us:[/h3]
Steam Page:[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/dream0v0]Eternal Dream[/url]
Twitter:[url=https://twitter.com/eternaldream0v0]EternalDream0v0[/url]
Youtube: [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCO0NOnJJzb3NoG00LH20Ggw/]EternalDream0v0[/url]
Discord: https://discord.gg/ysbxSfYaQs
Email: eternaldream0v0@163.com

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35458405/62dace4231f3e2859ee50e6cfcb5b00d465a13a5.png[/img]

Thank you for your support, and we will continue to do our best!
May we build together a second home for all of our games, just like Kepler-452b! ♥

Sincerely，

Eternal Dream Studio Yuriko0v0
2023.2.13

notes.title: 新作《XGAMEX》与我们的最新动态！
notes.content:
不好意思，最近失踪好久没有什么新消息~！实际上我们的新作《XGAMEX》已经在开发中啦！
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35458405/5a615359a732ca7524602cad018a7627c16eeaf3.png[/img]
由于我们还是小制作组，精力有限，更新和英文版的进度停滞了一些，
等到不忙碌的时候也会抓紧补上的！抱歉还要麻烦大家等待啦~！

[h2]↓关于我们的新作↓[/h2]
《XGAMEX》是梦结界工作室继《异化之恶》后的新作，一款meta式探索解谜RPG游戏。
本作融入了丰富的cg和动画演出，live2d立绘，近40首原创音乐，还邀请了hanser、森中人、微笑子等CV老师参与配音~ 
预计于2021年初正式发布，感兴趣就加入steam愿望单吧w 

[h2]↓steam页面传送门↓ [/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1393630/XGAMEX/
 
[h2]↓摩点页面传送门↓ [/h2]
http://mourl.cc/_zGZovLs

被困于像素拼筑的迷梦中，少女探寻着游戏唯一的出口。 
在《XGAMEX》里，你将与她携手同行，建立独特的羁绊，探索XGAMEX造设出的虚拟场景。拨开迷雾，寻找真相，打破通向世界彼侧的屏障。 
这款meta式探索解谜RPG游戏，欢迎您的加入~！

notes.title: 8.12更新~！(｀・ω・´)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35458405/d8a728dc987c1f7cfa3a9e30e7377b59e4f804e8.png[/img]
感谢大家的喜欢和支持~也感谢各种问题的反馈！新版本已尽可能修复了一些收集到的问题（详情见下方）
还有部分问题的解决尚需要时间，近期会处理的！><

Thanks to everybody and those who need 《异化之恶〇Abnormal Treatment》 to be translated into other languages. We are planning to develop English version and Japanese version, but currently preparing ~ If you can offer us any help, that would be great, please contact our email: eternaldream0v0@163.com.
Anyway, thanks to your support!o(｀・ω・´)o

（同时，感谢各位需要其他语言版本的朋友的喜欢，《异化之恶〇Abnormal Treatment》有计划制作英文版和日文版，不过还需要进行一些准备～如果您愿意提供相关的协助，也可以联系我们的邮箱eternaldream0v0@163.com。总之，感谢支持！o(｀・ω・´)o）

〇优化/更新内容：

1.追加了按下Shift可以穿透npc进门的功能，来解决npc对话与地图切换的冲突。
2.修正了按下F12会导致游戏重启的问题。
3.在部分关键分歧剧情之前加入了自动弹出的存档点。
4.追加了可一键跳过结局重复剧情，以及打通te后再次进入游戏可以按下ctrl键快进对话的功能。
5.修正了特典房间结局计数等收到反馈的小问题。
6.在特典★资料室中更新了图册、人物设定、简单的剧情设定集等内容。
7.追加了道具图。


〇待优化/更新的内容：

1.重置菜单，解决在菜单界面按Q或W可能会导致游戏报错退出的问题，并在菜单中追加已入队的角色立绘、任务提示，以及音量调节功能。
（*如果游戏出现了没有音乐或声音的问题，请按F1然后给『播放音乐』『播放声音』都打上钩。）
2.特典房间中尚未完成的扭蛋机、番外、换装。
3.计划解决全屏后出现的一些问题，还在寻找方法。(´；ω；｀)
4.计划加入一键查看地图的功能。

如果您还有什么问题或优化建议，可以通过简介上方的联系方式进行反馈～
(๑＞ڡ＜)☆ 真的非常感谢大家的包容和支持啦！我们还会继续加油～

kepler452b！（咦）

Eternal Dream工作室
2019/8/12
